loryk
Chisinau, Moldova3 contributions

Tra ley
Feb 2026 • Couples
We had been to this place before and really liked it in Da Nang, so we decided to visit again here in Hanoi.
At first, a girl was very kind and tried to help when we said it was hot, but then we were served by a guy with red hair named Tra Ley.

We were a bit confused about how to order the pizza because there are many options. He joked about me because I didn’t fully understand the ordering process.
We ordered two pizzas. One pizza we asked to be cut into 6 slices, but it was cut into 10.
For my wife, I ordered a pizza with extra toppings — onions and olives — and asked for it to be cut into 10 slices. It arrived cut into 8 slices and without olives, even though I clearly asked for them.

When I asked the waiter Tra Ley about this, he said that olives were an extra option, even though it had already been discussed and we had confirmed that we wanted them.

The table was not cleaned at all until we finished eating. It was very uncomfortable to eat because empty Coca-Cola and Schweppes bottles were left on the table. No one removed them — we had to move the bottles to the next table ourselves. Very strange service.

Later, he came and offered us a dessert as an apology.
We have been to this place three times in Da Nang, and there were always mistakes. This made us feel like mistakes happen on purpose just so they can apologize afterward.

I am from Italy, and I can confidently say that the pizza is very tasty.
But the service is terrible — even in the cheapest restaurant in Italy, the service is better.

Dear Mr./Ms. Loryk.

Thank you for sharing your experience with us on Tripadvisor. My name is Giang, Restaurant Manager at Pizza 4P’s Hoang Thanh in Hanoi.
First of all, I would like to sincerely apologize for the frustration your experienced during your visit. We truly appreciate you returning to Pizza 4P’s after enjoying our restaurant in Da Nang, and I am very sorry that our service in Hanoi did not reflect the standard you expected.

Your feedback regarding the ordering guidance, the incorrect slicing requests, the missing extra toppings, and especially the lack of table follow-up and cleaning during the meal is completely unacceptable. This is not the experience we aim to provide, and it is certainly not aligned with our Omotenashi spirit.
Please rest assured that we are taking your comments seriously. I will review the situation with the service team and kitchen immediately to strengthen our order confirmation process, improve communication between staff, and ensure proper table attention throughout the dining experience.

Thank you again for your honest feedback. We are glad you found the pizza delicious, and we truly hope we will have the chance to welcome you back in the future and provide you with the warm and attentive service Pizza 4P’s is known for.

Warm regards,

Wine served too slowly
Nov 2023 • Friends
I ordered Burrata cheese salad, pizza, and wine.

The wine I ordered first was a bottle, but it never got served.

They finally came to show me the bottle to confirm the brand, but it took a long time after that...
How long does it take to open a bottle, even though there are so many staff members?

Have there been no customers who have ordered wine at this restaurant before?

And even when they finally brought the opened wine, there was no tasting, and the cork was not brought to the table. I thought that was normal in Vietnam, but at a Vietnamese restaurant I went to later, they put the cork on the table properly.

I ordered an additional carafe, but it took a long time to open it again...

I went there thinking that I would eat in Hanoi first because it was open at Azabu Hills, but the service was disappointing. The Burrata cheese salad was delicious.
